svg.title: BeamFix terminal preview
svg.desc: Two example terminal sessions with simulated display data: a diagnostic report and guided troubleshooting for a disabled projector output.
svg.text: Example sessions with simulated display data. Colours follow your terminal theme.
Read-only diagnostics. No settings are changed.
An enabled output does not confirm a visible image.
[CHECK] The connector is connected but reported as disabled by
Try: This may be intentional. If you want to use this screen,
check that it is enabled in Display settings.
[LISTED] Current mode is listed as available by KDE.
Listed modes are not necessarily the mode currently in use.
Current mode: configured pixel resolution and Hz, not desktop
Listed by KDE does not guarantee that the projected image is
No changes applied. Image quality requires visual confirmation.
I will suggest one step at a time. You make any changes in your
settings; BeamFix reads the data again and asks what you see. You
can skip a step or exit with 0.
What do you see on the projector?
I can see the desktop, but not the presentation
Output names do not reliably identify the device or physical
Which output corresponds to the projector? You can compare it with
I am not sure / the projector is not listed
Step: Enable the output in Display settings
Why: Linux detects the selected display but reports its output as
Open your desktop's Display settings, identify the projector and
enable it. Keep the computer's screen on as well. Apply the
change and use the desktop's confirmation prompt if offered.
